    StartersGarlic parmesan stuffed mushroomsButton mushrooms filled with garlic butter, breadcrumbs and parmesanHow to make it500g button mushrooms, stalks removed100g butter, softened3 garlic cloves, crushed4 tbsp breadcrumbs50g parmesan, grated2 tbsp chopped parsleyMix the butter with garlic, breadcrumbs, parmesan and parsley.Press a spoonful into each mushroom cap.Bake at 200°C until golden and bubbling.Pastoral grape platterRed and green grapes, brie, fresh figs and honeyHow to make it500g red grapes500g green grapes200g brie6 fresh figs, halved4 tbsp honeyWash the grapes and pile them on a big platter.Add the brie at room temperature and halve the figs around it.Set a little pot of honey in the middle for drizzling.Hippo ballet gruyère puffsThe dancing hippos in the Dance of the HoursHow to make itAs written, serves 4Light, golden choux puffs beaten with gruyère and a little mustard, crisp outside and hollow inside, served warm.Boil 250ml water with 100g butter and a pinch of salt, tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 1 minute until it leaves the sides.Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy.Stir in 120g grated gruyère and 1 tsp Dijon mustard.Pipe 30 small balls onto lined trays, top with a little extra cheese and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.MainsLamb moussakaEggplant layered with cinnamon spiced lamb and tomatoHow to make it2 eggplants4 tbsp olive oil600g lamb mince1 brown onion, diced1 tsp ground cinnamon400g diced tomatoes60g butter60g plain flour600ml milk1 eggSlice the eggplants 1cm thick, brush with oil and grill or fry until golden.Brown the lamb with the onion and cinnamon, add the tomatoes and simmer.Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk until thick and beat in the egg off the heat.Layer eggplant and lamb in a dish and pour over the bechamel.Bake at 180°C until golden.Rite of Spring garlic rosemary lambThe dinosaurs in the Rite of SpringHow to make itAs written, serves 4Lamb leg studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted pink, sliced with crispy roast potatoes, pumpkin and a rich pan gravy.Make small cuts all over a 2kg lamb leg and push in slivers of 4 garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs.Rub with olive oil and salt.Roast at 180°C for 90 minutes for medium, with 1kg potato chunks and 600g pumpkin pieces tossed in oil around it.Rest the lamb 15 minutes.Stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the pan juices, add 300ml beef stock and simmer until thick.SweetsMeringue kissesSmall baked meringues, crisp outside and light insideHow to make it3 egg whites170g caster sugar1 tsp edible glitter250g raspberriesWhisk the egg whites to stiff peaks.Add the sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy.Pipe small kisses onto lined trays.Bake at 100°C, then cool in the oven.Dust with edible glitter and serve with raspberries.DrinksBacchus grape and rosemary soda spritzPurple grape juice with rosemary syrup and frozen grapesHow to make it200g red grapes3 tbsp caster sugar3 tbsp water2 rosemary sprigs, plus extra to garnish600ml purple grape juice1 lemon800ml sparkling waterFreeze the grapes on a tray.Simmer the sugar, water and rosemary, then cool.Mix the grape juice, rosemary syrup and lemon juice in a jug.Pour into goblets over the frozen grapes, top with sparkling water and garnish with rosemary.
